name: aerial_touch_short_flight
description: Blue car is already airborne at z 800 (airTime 0 at frame 0) and flies at 1500 uu/s into a ball floating at z 830. Car and ball fall together, so the hit lands about 0.2-0.3 s into the flight (3-4 steps). Hand calc: airFrac = 0.2-0.3 / 1.75 = 0.11-0.17; ballFrac = (about 810 - 150) / 1300 = 0.5, so heightFrac = airFrac (the MIN); the ball takes well over 500 uu/s of delta-v so impulseFrac = 1. Reward is about 0.11-0.17, a fraction of the full 1.0.

expect.intent: the car really touches the ball (PassingSetupReward's touched_ball gate is the witness; AerialTouchReward emits no gates)
a hit 0.2-0.3 s into the flight is paid about airTime/1.75 = 0.11-0.17: aerial credit grows with time in the air
